agreements: The retained finite synthetic world, fixed-envelope cadence, unpadded payload-age axis, OLD embargo, lineage-local nonmerging SELF lifecycle, sterility, failure inclusion, and representation-neutral terminal action score remain the strongest defensible construct core.
Eight nested DEV roots are descriptive/falsification observations only: no current C1--C5 claim, population inference, Stage C, Stage D, LoRA execution, or automatic successor authority follows.
The A2 premodel freeze must precede B0, and a genuinely post-B3 reporting disposition must not modify B3 cognition or execution.

The proposed repairs identify the right risk categories—ontology closure, fork least privilege, shortcut audit, native-resource accounting, attribution controls, and claim-language discipline—but exact V2 bytes do not yet make them constructible or internally consistent.

disagreements.issue: Both separately named AS-EXT candidates are required to execute every full-surface B3 cell while the proposal retains the six-arm 908-row/root roster and lets a post-B3 designation enter the favorable classifier.

positions.position: Both full candidate series require 1,036 target rows/root and 8,288 total; one row cannot contain two condition-specific outcomes or failures.
A post-B3 selected AS-EXT comparator is outcome-conditioned taxonomy selection, not reporting-only.

resolution.rationale: Preserving both native candidates and their complete failures is more scientifically defensible than collapsing conditions or selecting on outcomes.
resolution.selected_position: V3 must execute both candidates as full arms and change the frozen B3 ledger to exactly 1,036 assigned target-evaluation rows per root and 8,288 total; all resource, completeness, release, and gate arithmetic must use those numbers.
resolution.required_change: Delete every 908/7,264 assertion and recompute the row-key manifest, denominators, resource cap, T03/T05/T06/T08/T18/T20 language, and B3 release checks for 1,036/8,288. Freeze one primary AS-EXT comparator before B0 by a non-performance identity, or require favorable signs against the strongest executed AS-EXT candidate; POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION may designate a report view only and must be excluded from all classifier inputs.

disagreements.issue: A 27-by-8 field/stage matrix does not close the executable component universe and grants broader access than the lifecycle contracts permit.

positions.position: Required generator, allocator, renderer, scheduler, environment, scorer, installer, broker, resource, and audit roles are absent or conflated.
The current component-to-stage projection and positive-reader rules are contradictory.

resolution.rationale: Closure must quantify over the executable principals, not only coarse stage labels.
resolution.selected_position: Replace the stage-only closure assertion with a closed component registry and field-by-component policy.
resolution.required_change: Bind machine-readable component_registry.json with stable component IDs, parent stage, process boundary, allowed inputs/outputs, and total membership for every executable or audit principal. Bind field_registry.json and a total field_uid-by-component matrix derived by an explicit stage projection plus component intersection. Include generator, opportunity/target allocators and certifier, renderer, scheduler, environment executor, ordinary and evaluation installers/actors, scorer, resource auditor, broker, resetter, compiler, selector, and terminal auditor. Make selector access aggregate/hash derivatives only; terminal audit receives sealed assignment records and absence receipts, never live capabilities. Fail on an unknown component, absent matrix cell, or broader component permission.

disagreements.issue: field_uid depends circularly on a bundle hash and U_inst=E_inst treats mutually exclusive paths as though one execution emits all of them.

positions.position: Canonical prose traversal and a self-including digest cannot deterministically define fields or instances.
The equality proof requires per-trace planned slots and separate failure-path coverage.

resolution.rationale: Identity and equality are enforceable only over a non-self-referential machine-readable inventory and explicit trace domains.
resolution.selected_position: Use generated IDs from a prehash schema-set digest and trace-indexed equality.
resolution.required_change: Define schema_set_digest as the canonical digest of machine-readable schemas and the prose-to-schema inventory, explicitly excluding generated field_uid values, registries, and receipts. Define field_uid=SHA256(schema_set_digest||source_schema_digest||canonical_schema_path||wire_tag||version). Give every field a finite instance-key grammar. For each legal trace t, require Planned(t)=Emitted(t), including fixed failure placeholders; separately require union over a frozen success/NULL/malformed/timeout/denied/reset/crash/unavailable fixture suite to cover every planned alternative. Replace COMPOUND_RESTRICTED with base_class plus ordered taint_source_classes and compute direct permissions as their intersection, so a compound field has a usable only-if-intersection policy rather than an all-forbidden placeholder.

disagreements.issue: Nonreifiable write-only capabilities and literal destruction are asserted without a threat model, trusted boundary, or implementable remote-state semantics.

positions.position: Ordinary in-process Python objects and distributed handles are inspectable or reifiable; a routing fabric necessarily has metadata.
Capability, cache, log, timing, and provider descendants need a defined destruction meaning.

resolution.rationale: A modest explicit TCB and logical non-reachability are defensible; unverifiable physical erasure is not.
resolution.selected_position: Implement the fork through a named broker/TCB and isolated local workers, with logical revocation plus teardown rather than claimed universal physical erasure.
resolution.required_change: Bind adversary_model.json and broker_tcb_contract.json. The broker alone owns fresh single-use opaque channels; randomizer and installer run in distinct isolated processes with declared IPC, syscall, filesystem, network, log, cache, crash-dump, credential, and transcript policies. Each semantic-mutation trial receives fresh matched channels, and the test compares canonical public transcripts/shapes rather than handle identity. Define destruction as broker revocation, worker/process teardown, deletion of declared local storage, and a post-teardown non-reachability audit. Exclude remote providers from fork treatment, or bind a provider retention/cache guarantee sufficient for this logical-destruction contract. Add broker as a registry component and test success and every failure path.

disagreements.issue: Equal provider seeds and requests do not establish the claimed equality of compiler draws index by index.

positions.position: Remote/provider sampling can diverge through backend, cache, request-order, or stopping behavior.
The claimed exact-draw property must either be implemented locally or weakened.

resolution.rationale: The causal paired-draw language is retained only if the sampler can actually expose and freeze the draws.
resolution.selected_position: V3 must use a pinned local deterministic compiler sampler for P1 paired randomness.
resolution.required_change: Bind sampler build hash, counter-based uniform-stream algorithm, sample/token-position counter key, fixed token-consumption/stopping rule, canonical request bytes, and golden vectors. Log the counter range consumed by every lane; require matching lanes to have equal streams and cuts/shams to consume no new stream. If this cannot be implemented, replace every exact-draw statement with paired canonical seed/request equality and remove any draw-equality causal wording; do not silently use provider seed equality as a substitute.

disagreements.issue: V1 claim artifacts, active confirmation/mediation paths, T10 evidence text, and T11 state vocabulary contradict V2's descriptive-only contract.

positions.position: No V2 namespace/applicability mapping binds replacements for retired IDs, so T11 and T16 cannot pass.
The retained mediation ID must be visibly constrained to a non-formal causal-cascade diagnostic.

resolution.rationale: Machine-readable names and evidence paths are part of the claim surface, so prose cannot cure them.
resolution.selected_position: Create V3-native namespace, applicability, and semantic-lint registries.
resolution.required_change: Add hash-bound V3 claim_namespace_map.json and claim_test_applicability.json whose exact sets cover only current IDs and V3 tests; preserve the empty current claim set. Set T10 evidence_artifact exactly to NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED and store NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D in a separate status field. Make T11 emit only NOT_RUN, REJECT, STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID, FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE, or PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL. Move T03 evidence under artifacts/pcfl_active_stream/stage_b/randomized_unmounted_causal_cascade.json and bind the immutable T03 ID to display name 'randomized unmounted causal-cascade diagnostic — not formal mediation'; lint rejects standalone mediation, confirmation, power, plateau, revision-efficacy, and LoRA-execution achievement language in every identifier, graph node, evidence path, figure, and status. Rename retention-NI everywhere to FINITE_RETENTION_TOLERANCE_DESCRIPTIVE_SIGN with an explicit deterministic root-vector predicate.

disagreements.issue: T04 treats favorable efficacy signs as conformance although a correctly measured unfavorable B3 surface is supposed to be a valid complete null.

positions.position: Control integrity and observed direction must not be one pass/fail predicate.
B1/B2 spending stops must likewise be separated from B3 conformance and descriptive classification.

resolution.rationale: A validity gate must be invariant to the favorable/null sign it measures.
resolution.selected_position: Split integrity/conformance, B1/B2 promotion, and B3 descriptive signs into separate frozen predicates.
resolution.required_change: Rewrite T04 so its pass condition is complete, shape-correct, target-blind, failure-inclusive execution and intervention recording for either sign; emit the observed SELF/control directions as named descriptive facts consumed only after procedure seal. Bind separate B1_PROMOTION and B2_PROMOTION predicates and explicit B1/B2 early-stop events. Add a mutation fixture in which all conformance bytes pass but one B3 favorable sign is false; it must classify PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL, never STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID. No acceptance test may require a favorable B3 efficacy sign for conformance.

disagreements.issue: The terminal taxonomy has missing abort/reject exits, reviewer/classifier circularity, and an incorrectly null-only renderer limitation.

positions.position: The state machine is neither total nor acyclic.
A deterministic transition table must cover each phase/event and renderer limitation must be orthogonal.

resolution.rationale: Exactly one terminal disposition requires a finite ordered transition table whose facts are sealed before review and classification.
resolution.selected_position: Use PROCEDURE_SEAL -> INDEPENDENT_REVIEW -> deterministic TERMINAL_CLASSIFICATION, with orthogonal limitation tags.
resolution.required_change: Bind terminal_transition_table.json enumerating every state/event pair for PROPOSAL_ONLY, B0, B1, B2, B3, PROCEDURE_SEAL, INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, and TERMINAL_CLASSIFICATION. Before any dispatch only NOT_RUN is legal; after dispatch any abort, missing assigned work, or unsealed required cell at any phase maps to STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID:INCOMPLETE_AFTER_DISPATCH; any construct/shortcut/B1/B2 validity failure maps to STOP with reason; a sealed-package independent-review provenance/reproduction/claim-lint failure maps to REJECT; only a passed procedure seal and accepted independent review reach deterministic favorable/null classification. Reviewer validates sealed facts and classifier output but is not an input to procedure validity. RENDERER_BOUNDARY is an orthogonal limitation tag applicable to either complete terminal class and forces renderer-bounded language. Mechanically exhaust transitions for totality, exclusivity, precedence, and acyclicity.

disagreements.issue: Shortcut, one-return, memory-dependent-path, and model-owned-path requirements lack finite executable algorithms and overstate what finite audits can exclude.

positions.position: Natural-language determination and directional separation need typed controller predicates, dataflow, thresholds, and aggregation.
A held-out audit needs a frozen domain before outcomes and can support only bounded conclusions.

resolution.rationale: Finite red teams are valuable falsifiers, not proofs against all pretrained semantic priors.
resolution.selected_position: Bind finite audit manifests and limit conclusions to their declared audit domain.
resolution.required_change: Add shortcut_audit_manifest.json and path_attribution_manifest.json before A2 with held-out root/renderer/label roster, attack/predictor/controller builds, features, seeds, training partition, selection rule, typed action/trajectory predicates, solution thresholds, failure mapping, root/stratum reducer, and opening receipt. Instrument every return-to-query/action dependency with immutable dataflow IDs and provide an exact counterfactual replay predicate for MEMORY_DEPENDENT_PATH_USE. Define MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE control separation as a frozen per-item inequality and a named root reducer against MISBOUND_MEMORY and RAW_EVIDENCE_POLICY. State only that no registered excluded route passed the finite audit; any passing hard route remains STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID.

disagreements.issue: Pareto dominance is undefined for NOT_MEASURED or differently accounted resource coordinates.

positions.position: A pairwise applicability and accounting rule is required.
Energy may be NOT_MEASURED although every mandatory coordinate is used in dominance.

resolution.rationale: Partial dominance is meaningful only on a prospectively identical, observed coordinate set.
resolution.selected_position: Use a frozen coordinate schema and pairwise applicability mask; applicable missingness makes the pair ineligible.
resolution.required_change: Bind resource_coordinate_schema.json before B0: coordinate ID, unit, direction, precision/rounding, measurement boundary, shared-cost and concurrency allocation, total/amortized view, and pairwise applicability mask. A coordinate may be excluded only if prospectively declared inapplicable to both compared configurations and reported. If any applicable coordinate is NOT_MEASURED, incomparable, or differently accounted, mark that pair PARETO_INELIGIBLE and prohibit dominance/efficiency language. Keep RESOURCE_INCOMPLETE for missing mandatory capture and never impute zero.

disagreements.issue: B1/B2-only misbound/raw controls cannot support MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE labels in an uninstrumented eight-root B3 release.

positions.position: B3 can report terminal and memory-dependent quantities, but model-owned attribution needs matched controls.
Either instrument every B3 attribution label or restrict the label to B1/B2.

resolution.rationale: Adding unbudgeted control rows would compound the already repaired roster; scope separation is clearer.
resolution.selected_position: Restrict MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE, control-separation results, and related language to predeclared instrumented B1/B2 diagnostics; B3 reports terminal action and MEMORY_DEPENDENT_PATH_USE only.
resolution.required_change: Remove MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE from B3 root summaries, P1--P4, favorable signs, and release language unless a future separately ratified design assigns failure-inclusive matched controls to every B3 label and updates the 1,036-row ledger. Tag each B1/B2 attribution output with its exact gate-item domain and forbid projection to B3 roots.

disagreements.issue: The current requested scope authorizes only deliberation already completed and explicitly forbids the implementation/fixture work required by the proposal.

positions.position: Ratification is retrospective unless there is a bounded A0--A2 successor request.
It is valid as a governance receipt but does not advance construct feasibility.

resolution.rationale: The authority firewall is correct, but its effect must be stated truthfully and any next scope must be separately chosen by a human.
resolution.selected_position: Treat this V2 consensus as a nonauthorizing governance recommendation and require a new exact scope after V3 repair for A0--A2 implementation/CPU fixtures only.
resolution.required_change: Keep this artifact human_required and implementation_forbidden. In V3, add a nonauthorizing graph node MAY_REQUEST_SCOPED_A0_A2_IMPLEMENTATION that can only recommend a new human decision. Draft a separate exact follow-on scope that enumerates only registry/schema/broker/runtime/test implementation and CPU fixture certification through A2; it must forbid B0/B1/B2/B3 dispatch, model/provider calls, GPU, training, Stage C/D, LoRA, claims, publication, and successor launch. Do not present ratification of V2 as authorizing that work.

disagreements.issue: The systems interpreter identified unresolved bundle-hash, component projection, row identity, destruction, RNG, semantic-audit, review-order, and ratification-effect ambiguities.

positions.position: Each ambiguity prevents implementation from having one deterministic reading.
The preceding V3 resolutions select a concrete reading for each ambiguity.

resolution.rationale: A rework recommendation must select rather than merely list ambiguous alternatives.
resolution.selected_position: Use RES_V3_FIELD_IDENTITY_AND_TRACE_EQUALITY, RES_V3_COMPONENT_AND_FIELD_CLOSURE, RES_V3_ROSTER_AND_AS_EXT, RES_V3_BROKER_TCB_AND_LOGICAL_DESTRUCTION, RES_V3_PAIRED_RANDOMNESS, RES_V3_FINITE_SHORTCUT_AND_PATH_AUDITS, RES_V3_TOTAL_TERMINAL_MACHINE, and RES_V3_ACTIONABLE_RATIFICATION_SCOPE respectively.
resolution.required_change: V3 must contain no unresolved choice on those eight topics; each selected semantics must be hash-bound in the named machine-readable artifact before human review.

disagreements.issue: The benchmark interpreter identified unresolved AS-EXT comparator, retention wording, red-team decision rule, and B1/B2 attribution-scope ambiguities.

positions.position: Each ambiguity can alter classification or overstate the finite scientific conclusion.
The selected V3 resolutions remove outcome-conditioned selection and make the finite scope explicit.

resolution.rationale: The paper language and finite descriptive boundary are preserved only under precommitted comparator and audit semantics.
resolution.selected_position: Use strongest/pre-B0 AS-EXT comparison, finite retention-tolerance terminology, finite held-out audit manifests, and B1/B2-only model-owned attribution.
resolution.required_change: V3 must make these four choices explicit in the classifier, lint registry, shortcut manifest, and release schema; no post-B3 selector, inferential noninferiority term, open-ended semantic absence claim, or B3 projection of B1/B2 control evidence is permitted.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Two complete AS-EXT arms add 128 condition-specific target rows/root.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Adopt 1,036 rows/root and 8,288 total; regenerate all arithmetic.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Observed-output designation cannot select a claim-facing comparator.
Noninferiority is inferential terminology forbidden by the finite DEV contract.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use FINITE_RETENTION_TOLERANCE_DESCRIPTIVE_SIGN and a deterministic root-vector rule.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Stage coverage is not component authorization.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a complete component registry and field-by-component policy.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Current identity is circular and equality ignores alternative traces.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use prehash schema IDs, per-trace equality, and suite-union coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The asserted properties need an explicit trusted boundary.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind broker TCB, isolation, revocation/teardown, and remote-provider policy.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Provider seed pairing is weaker than common random draws.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use logged local counter-based draws or weaken every draw-equality claim.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Current exact IDs, paths, and vocabulary fail the proposed lint.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind V3-native namespace/applicability/lint artifacts and corrected T03/T10/T11 semantics.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A valid observed null must remain a procedural completion.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Separate conformance, B1/B2 promotion, and B3 descriptive facts.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The stated machine has gaps and review/classifier circularity.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Finite empirical gates need frozen algorithms and bounded claims.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Identity and trace equality must be made constructive.
Least privilege needs an implementable TCB.
Seed equality is not draw equality.
Active bytes must agree with the nonclaim contract.
Validity and result sign are different layers.
Terminal classification must be total and acyclic.
Finite audit claims need a finite domain.
Least privilege must be represented in the closure matrix.
Post-B3 selector must not affect classification.
Inferential naming violates the language lock.
The immutable registry ID may remain for continuity, but its displayed and claim-bearing semantics must be non-formal causal cascade.
Governance-only ratification must not be represented as implementation progress.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain construct checks but bind them to the V3 component/field registries and 1,036-row ledger.
Bind finite controller builds, typed predicates, thresholds, and audit aggregation.
Use V3 arithmetic, broker TCB, local paired draws, and non-formal causal-cascade display/path semantics.
Make conformance sign-independent and retain observed directions only for terminal classification.
Require both AS-EXT arms, pre-B0 classifier comparator, and taxonomy invariance to post-B3 disposition.
Use 8,288 rows, finite retention-tolerance language, and supported B3 attribution only.
Test field-by-component closure, logical destruction, and local paired-draw invariants.
Recompute roster/resources and state governance-only scope plus separate A0--A2 request.
Bind the V3 namespace projection and preserve integrity-only status.
Require literal NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED and separate NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D status.
Use V3 namespace/applicability sets and acyclic terminal vocabulary.
Bind broker/sampler/runtime hashes and exclude unresolved provider randomness.
Use noncircular IDs, trace equality, suite coverage, and component closure.
Test named broker TCB, fresh matched channels, teardown, and all failure transcripts.
Require no selector-to-classifier or selector-to-B3 path and both AS-EXT completions.
Lint V3-native IDs, aliases, paths, retention wording, and classifier inputs.
Bind finite held-out roster, algorithms, seeds, thresholds, and bounded conclusion.
Bind coordinate schema, applicability mask, accounting, and ineligible missingness.
Bind typed path/control algorithms and limit model-owned attribution to B1/B2 diagnostics.
Use an acyclic total classifier, orthogonal renderer tag, V3 names, and 8,288 release rule.
Route only from total valid terminal states and add only a nonauthorizing A0--A2 scope-request node.

questions: Do you accept rework rather than ratification of the internally inconsistent V2 bytes, while preserving its descriptive-only scientific boundary?
Do you approve the selected V3 repair choice to run both AS-EXT full arms at 1,036 rows/root and 8,288 total, with a pre-B0/strongest comparator and no classifier input from POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION?

After V3 passes a fresh deliberation, should a separate exact human scope be considered for A0--A2 implementation and CPU fixtures only, with all scientific dispatch, model/provider calls, GPU work, training, Stage C/D, LoRA, and claims still forbidden?
